title: 모음 21개 표 읽기: 우유, 사과, 시계
objective: Read all 21 vowels and say easy words with them.
summary: Read all 21 Korean vowels in one table.

task.title: Read and build vowels
task.line: Use the vowel table on page 1 to sort, combine and read each vowel.

letters.as: Six simple vowels: keep your mouth still from start to end.
ㅐ and ㅔ sound almost the same; ㅚ is often said [ㅞ].
Add a quick y- sound: ㅑ = y + ㅏ, like 'ya' in yard.
Glide from ㅗ, ㅜ or ㅡ; ㅢ after a consonant says [ㅣ].

exercises: Is the vowel in the first syllable a y-vowel or a w-vowel? Write y or w: ① 여자 ② 과자 ③ 휴지
Add a y- sound and write the new vowel: ① ㅏ → ____ ② ㅗ → ____ ③ ㅔ → ____
Put the two vowels together and write one vowel: ① ㅗ + ㅏ = ____ ② ㅜ + ㅓ = ____ ③ ㅜ + ㅔ = ____
Write how each word really sounds in [ ]: ① 의자 ② 희다 ③ 지혜
answers: ① y (ㅕ) ② w (ㅘ) ③ y (ㅠ)
① ㅑ ② ㅛ ③ ㅖ
① ㅘ ② ㅝ ③ ㅞ
